questions.explainKo: ③ recycle의 영영풀이는 ‘to make something new again from used things’. ‘to make something smaller or less’는 reduce. (답지 20쪽)
questions.promptEn:
01 다음 단어의 영영풀이가 잘못된 것은?
① useful: helpful or practical
② save: not to use too much of something
③ recycle: to make something smaller or less
④ completely: fully or totally, with nothing left out
⑤ waste: things that are not needed or are thrown away
choices: save: not to use too much of something
recycle: to make something smaller or less
completely: fully or totally, with nothing left out
waste: things that are not needed or are thrown away
